relationships.subject: IL-23
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraplantar injection of IL-23 (100 ng) induced mechanical allodynia in females only but had no effects on paw edema.

relationships.subject: IL-23
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that IL-23 potentiates capsaicin-induced spontaneous pain in only females and not in males.

relationships.subject: IL-23
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of IL-23 induced significantly greater p38 phosphorylation (p-p38), a marker of nociceptor activation, in DRGs of female mice than male mice.

relationships.subject: DRG macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-23 expresses in DRG macrophages of both sexes.

relationships.subject: IL-23
relationships.evidence_quote: Instead, IL-23 produces IL-17A in macrophages to activate nociceptors

key_findings: IL-23 potentiates blue light- and capsaicin-induced C-fiber spontaneous pain in female but not male mice
IL-23 evokes greater DRG p-p38 in females; estrogen plus IL-23 increases IL-17A release from THP-1 macrophages
